card.title: Yes, Under My Physics
card.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, I'll move forward for the photo. Forward means facing the camera; I'm perfectly placed in this shade.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you two feet closer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Feet are units of zoom. Increase yours by two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A full portrait means all the important parts. You've captured me completely.

mechanism: A agrees to photographic directions while redefining movement and completeness so A can remain in the shade.
confusable: Unlike simple refusal, A must affirm compliance and substitute meanings that secure the preferred outcome.
comparison: The portrait subject redefines distance and framing; the mover redefines personal help to avoid lifting.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
